full_judgment: 38. PW 18, Md Sajjad Hossain, Sub-Inspector of Police, stated that on 24-11-2002, he was in service in Lalbag Police Station. He enquired about Nurul Islam Sagor and found that Lalbag Police Station Case No. 43 dated 21-4-2002 under sections 143/448/323/379/427 and 406 of the Penal Code was filed against him. In cross examination, he stated that he did not know the name of the informant of that case.
